# Asina Global

> Florida-based project supply for cabinetry, countertops, and custom furniture packages. Asina Global coordinates project review, design-to-production support, quality checks, packing, and shipping with its manufacturing partner.

Use the following current pages as the source for public information. Product selections, compatibility, pricing, and project details are confirmed during project review.

## Product journey

- [Overview](https://asinaglobal.com/): Project supply overview and guided product journey.
- [Cabinet specifications](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-specifications/): Cabinet construction, box materials, separate door and drawer front options, and technical notes.
- [Door profiles](https://asinaglobal.com/door-profiles/): Cataloged door profile references for project review.
- [Materials and finishes](https://asinaglobal.com/materials-finishes/): Finish families, indexed records, relative price comparison, and TFL references.
- [Cabinet configurations](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-configurations/): Quick Book reference; final layouts follow the approved project plan.
- [Accessories](https://asinaglobal.com/accessories/): Cabinet storage accessories and custom hood-cover references.
- [Countertops](https://asinaglobal.com/countertops/): Quartz, granite, and laminate surfaces, material comparison, and edge-profile visuals.
- [Complete room](https://asinaglobal.com/complete-room/): Room applications, popular pairings, hardware, and transformations.
- [Project FAQs](https://asinaglobal.com/project-faqs/): Answers about products and project review.

- [Buyer paths](https://asinaglobal.com/buyer-paths/): Commercial buyer and supply paths.
- [Project supply and importer resources](https://asinaglobal.com/project-supply-importer-resources/): Planning information for cost, timing, and shipping responsibility.
- [Process](https://asinaglobal.com/process/): Design-to-production, quality, packing, and shipping coordination.
- [Project review](https://asinaglobal.com/project-review/): Start a consultation-led project review.
- [Privacy policy](https://asinaglobal.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy information for project review inquiries.
